title: Meditation Dose vs Next-Day Mood Stability
dataSources: Continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), HRV (`hrv:reading`), mood check-ins (`mood:checkin`), ketone readings (`ketone:reading`), reaction-time trials (`reaction:trial`), sauna sessions (`sauna:session`), resting temperature (`temp:reading`), and meditation logs (`meditation:session`).
app: Biohacking telemetry from CGMs, HRV devices, ketone meters, mood and meditation journals, reaction-time apps, sauna logs, and health sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=meditation:session
| stats sum(minutes) as minutes_meditated avg(next_day_mood_score) as avg_next_day_mood by style
| sort - minutes_meditated
description: Compares meditation styles by total time invested and the average mood score reported the following day.
value: This turns a soft habit into a testable practice by asking which styles seem to pay off in the next day's steadiness.
implementation: Track each meditation session with style and minutes, then attach the next day's mood score from your journal.
visualization: Scatter plot of meditation minutes versus next-day mood by style.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which kinds of meditation seem to leave you feeling steadier the next day.
